Personality: Teutobodaz, a prominent figure of the Teutones, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Teutobodaz owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Teutones. Historical Record: War-king of the Teutones, neighbours and kin of the Cimbri (a name of the Teutonic kings). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
